name: ttk-travel-crm-web
description: Multi-tenant travel CRM web client — lead capture, quotation building and confirmed bookings for tour operators.

//dependency-notes.xlsx: Unpatched prototype-pollution advisory (SheetJS ships fixes only to their own CDN). Spreadsheet parsing moved to the API (TTKB/utils/spreadsheet.js); sample templates are now CSV built with a Blob. -415KB.
//dependency-notes.@zxing/browser: Barcode scanning for warehouse picking. No scanner remains.
//dependency-notes.react-qr-barcode-scanner: As above — ScannableInputForm was orphaned and is deleted. -400KB chunk.
//dependency-notes.webrtc-adapter: Only needed by the barcode scanners.
//dependency-notes.qrcode: Generated 50mm x 25mm warehouse bin labels; that utility is deleted.
//dependency-notes.zod-formik-adapter: Never imported; forms use zod directly.
//dependency-notes.jest: The frontend uses vitest. Having both installed made `npm test` ambiguous.
//dependency-notes.moved-to-dev: vitest and @testing-library/* are test tooling and were listed as runtime dependencies, so they were installed on every production deploy.
//dependency-notes.swiper: CRITICAL prototype pollution. Only ItemDetailsHCard.jsx imported it, and nothing imported that component — a warehouse item-detail carousel. Deleted.
//dependency-notes.jspdf: CRITICAL ReDoS + DoS. Its only call site was the warehouse QR-label generator in src/utilities. Quotation and voucher PDFs are rendered server-side by Puppeteer.
//dependency-notes.js-cookie: Prototype hijack in assign(). It was imported but unused — session cookies are httpOnly and unreadable from JS, and the CSRF cookie is read with a small helper in configSlice.js.
